summary: Migration becomes demand-driven: a Product migrates when a concrete workflow needs it, with no prescribed sequence and no retirement-sequence obligation. Nothing mandates shadow operation, a cutover checklist, a migration record, a quarantine mechanism, or a generic non-Domain replacement relation. The delivered importer safeguards bind when a Product migrates, and the Domain-overlap execution block, append-only events, fold-only projections, immutable schema migrations, and the v4.7.0 operator surfaces are unchanged.
title: Migration is demand-driven
